versions.content: The role of pretended networking Pretended networking is a feature to reduce energy consumption of an ECU by switching the ECU in a mode called Pretended Networking . In this mode the communication on communication networks is reduced and the ECU can go into power saving modes. When communication via communication networks is required, the mode Pretended Networking shall be left by request of a mode change to Normal Mode .
